responsibility: Implements the internal ChanId storage record that backs gm2 ISO channel objects, with fields for the owning device id, device-table pointer, and associated FIO file handle. It owns allocation and disposal of ChanId records and provides simple accessors and mutators used by IOLink, RTfio, StdChans, and the various file-device modules to connect abstract channels to their runtime state.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file provides the concrete ChanId backing store by defining the record fields for device id, device-table pointer, and FIO file handle and implementing their accessors. RTio.def, by contrast, only publishes those operations while keeping ChanId opaque to users of the interface.
